# Stephen J Newhouse

> Personal site of Dr Stephen J Newhouse, PhD. Head of Professional Services & Senior Bioinformatician at Biorelate Ltd. (Manchester, UK). 20+ years across academia, NHS, and industry in bioinformatics, genomics, ML, and life-sciences data science. Currently focused on knowledge graphs, NLP, RAG, multi-omics, and agentic AI for target, drug, and biomarker discovery, and personalised medicine.

## About

- Name: Stephen J Newhouse (Dr, PhD)
- Aliases: sjnewhouse, s_j_newhouse, Steve Newhouse
- Current role: Head of Professional Services & Senior Bioinformatician
- Current employer: Biorelate Ltd. (https://www.biorelate.com)
- Location: Manchester, England, United Kingdom
- Languages: English (native)
- Areas of expertise: bioinformatics, genomics, NGS, multi-omics, machine learning, NLP, knowledge graphs, RAG, agentic AI, LLM systems, biostatistics, drug discovery, biomarker discovery, target discovery, indication expansion, systems biology, predictive modelling, time-series, biomedical text mining, open science, reproducible research, Agile delivery, data management
- Top skills (LinkedIn): Agile Methodologies, Data Management, Natural Language Processing (NLP)

## Career timeline

- 2021-06 → present  Head of Professional Services & Senior Bioinformatician, Biorelate Ltd. (Manchester, UK). £1M+/yr revenue contribution; built and led the Professional Services team.
- 2021-01 → 2021-06  Data Scientist, Grid Edge (UK). Built EDA + ML web app (Streamlit, PyCaret, Prophet, MLflow, Docker) for multivariate time-series.
- 2019-08 → 2020-02  Chief Technology Officer (interim, head-hunted), Mindwave Ventures, now Claryon Systems (London, UK; UK & India teams). NHS-focused digital health; led containerisation, Docker security, and a UK/India distributed engineering team.
- 2017-12 → 2019-08  Honorary Senior Lecturer, UCL (London, UK).
- 2015-11 → 2019-08  Bioinformatics Module Lead, Genomic Medicine MSc, KCL & SGUL.
- 2015-11 → 2019-08  Data Science Group Lead, Dept of Biostatistics & Health Informatics, King's College London.
- 2015-03 → 2019-08  Associate Member, MRC SGDP, Institute of Psychiatry, KCL.
- 2011-09 → 2019-08  Senior Bioinformatician, NIHR BRC for Mental Health, Institute of Psychiatry, KCL.
- 2010-01 → 2011-09  Postdoctoral Researcher, Institute of Psychiatry, KCL.
- 2009-01 → 2010-01  Postdoctoral Research Fellow, University of Cambridge.
- 2006-12 → 2009-01  Postdoctoral Research Fellow, Queen Mary, University of London.
